svg.title: INC-001 attack chain: what the attacker did, and what stopped or caught it
svg.text: What the attacker did, and what stopped or caught
"Detected now" = a rule written the same night, after
Root login over SSH is switched off. 18 guesses
Only checks that the password works
Two new IPs log in on the first try
Rule 100210 raises a High incident. That night
it was only a level-3 login.
Pushes its tools in over SCP
Dropper and script copied in through the login
Blocking outbound traffic cannot stop files
coming in. auditd logged every copy.
Delete Google's agent, swap ps, freeze /etc/shadow
The bait account has no root rights. Every one
Also changes the admin password to lock rivals out
Rule 100212 watches every file in the bait
A 4th IP logs in with that key
Rule 100213 raises a High incident for any key
Rule 100211, written during the attack, caught
Both files were archived at 02:39, before they
The miner calls its mining pool
10,684 attempts in 13 hours. Not one got out, so
Not reached: root access, outbound connections, other
hosts. Isolation was ready if the agent went offline,
the victim probed the gateway, or root appeared.
